summary: This is a minimal web server that listens on port 8080 and responds with a greeting message to any request. It registers a handler for the root path, logs when the server starts, and will exit if the server encounters a fatal error.

explanations.10: HandleFunc registers a function to handle HTTP requests to a specific path — in this case '/', which matches any request to the root of the server.
explanations.11: Fprintln writes text to the HTTP response writer 'w', which sends the message back to the client's browser.
explanations.15: ListenAndServe starts the server on port 8080 and blocks indefinitely; log.Fatal will print any error and exit the program if the server fails to start or crashes.
